summary: Richard Bråse discusses his transition from Dagens Industri journalist to fund manager at Protean Fund, sharing insights on his contrarian investment philosophy. He emphasizes buying when stocks are down and cheap, focusing on free cash flow analysis over thematic investing. He shares specific cases including his complete exit from Novo Nordisk due to loss of confidence in their pipeline, his position in Getinge as a potential turnaround story, and views on real estate sector challenges.
key_takeaways: Konträr investering: köp när andra säljer och aktier är billiga
